description: Table Plume replaces the native table with a grid you format column by column. Drop columns and measures in Columns: click a header to sort, drag its edge to widen it, search across the whole table, and keep the first column and the total row in view while you scroll. FREE, NO WATERMARK - Sort by clicking a header (natural sort: 2 before 10), then reverse, then model order; also from the keyboard - Column widths: automatic, stretched to the visual, resized with the mouse (saved in the report) or fixed - Accent-insensitive search across the whole table, row count ("3 of 12 rows") - Frozen first column and headers, row numbers, banded rows, three densities, gridlines - Total row at the top or bottom: automatic, sum, average, minimum, maximum or count, column by column - Per-column formatting with "Apply settings to": alignment, units, decimals, prefix, suffix, colored negatives, bold, colors, width - Clickable Web URL columns - Large tables: only visible rows are drawn, up to 100,000 rows - Dynamic formats: any Format pane setting driven by a DAX measure - Selection and cross-filtering, context menu, keyboard navigation, screen readers, high contrast, English and French - Custom colors: background, text, secondary text, lines, accent, favorable / unfavorable and the color-scale gradient; Minimal and Black & White styles PREMIUM (★, additional purchase) - Sparklines: drop a date…
